prompt.text: Create a tasteful portrait-oriented anime fashion illustration of an adult woman, age 24, with a cute playful expression, looking at the camera in a cozy European cafe at golden hour. She wears a cream blouse, charcoal pleated skirt, tailored cropped jacket, sheer black stockings, loafers, and a small ribbon hair clip; she is seated sideways at a small marble table with latte art, a sketchbook, and warm window light. Composition: three-quarter fashion portrait, elegant legs visible but relaxed and non-explicit, wholesome editorial mood, no nudity, no lingerie, no school uniform, no explicit pose, adult character only. Use polished modern anime rendering, crisp line art, luminous eyes, soft cel shading, subtle fabric texture, gentle blush, background bokeh, and a refined magazine-cover color palette.
